gap: No family in this registry reads 410(a)'s base definition of employment. Service within the United States is employment "irrespective of the citizenship or residence of either" (clause (A)); service outside the United States is employment only "by a citizen or resident of the United States as an employee (i) of an American employer" or of a foreign affiliate (clause (B)), and before 1984 only by "a citizen of the United States" (Pub. L. 98-21 section 323(a)(2), for remuneration paid after 1983). So a residual that reads covered does not reach a noncitizen's service abroad (before 1984 any noncitizen's, from 1984 a nonresident noncitizen's), for a Federal employer as for any other: POMS RS 01901.340 A names "services performed outside the U.S. by an alien" as excluded by some other provision of law (review r6 M-5).
